step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Type “No return call from the client.”
Select Save .

step.cmd: Create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Unable to reach client — 21 - Claimant refuses payment disentitlement (D21) imposed from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”

Details: Choose the appropriate option:
If a D21 is imposed for a period equal to the repayment amount, type: “Attempts to reach the client were made on [date and time] and [date and time of second call or date the letter or email was sent]. Client did not contact Service Canada and additional information is required. A 21 - Claimant refuses payment disentitlement (D21) is imposed from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] / [add other periods, if necessary]. The D21 imposed equals the amount repaid by the client. The client’s eligibility for the EI ERB has not been evaluated. This repayment was accepted under the authority provided under EIA 44. An amended T4E will be issued to the client.”
If an amount of the repayment remains and must be returned to the client, type: “Attempts to reach the client were made on [date and time] and [date and time of second call or date the letter or email wase sent]. Client did not contact Service Canada and additional information is required. A 21 - Claimant refuses payment disentitlement (D21) is imposed from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] / [add other periods, if necessary]. The D21 imposed does not equal the amount repaid by the client. Any amount repaid in excess will be credited to the client. The client’s eligibility for the EI ERB has not been evaluated. This repayment was accepted under the authority provided under EIA 44. An amended T4E will be issued to the client.”
Select Save .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine the blocked status by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 10.
If any other status is displayed, go to step 21.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 11.
If all rows are blank, go to step 13.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable status in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 11.
If all rows are blank, go to step 13.

step.cmd: Select the BPC that must be updated from the Benefit Period Commencement column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised (or 2 - Renewal , if necessary).
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In BCS, on the Disentitlements tab, in the Disentitlements section, enter the D21 as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 21 - Claimant refuses payment .
Start Date: Enter the start date of the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date of the disentitlement or type “ 9999” if the end date is indefinite.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction displayed is incorrect, go to step 16.
If the transaction displayed is correct, select Close and go to step 17.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Select Close .
Return to step 13.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Moved to Pending to check for BCS reject.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: In FTS, when the WI moves to the current workload, determine if there is a B112 or B100 error code for the BCS inputs:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 19.
If no go to step 24.

step.cmd: In BCS, select the appropriate BPC that shows Yes in the Results column and do the following:

ul.li: Select the Results tab.
Select the BPC with the estimated result that must be sent to IPOC and select the Forward via MM06 link.

When the Renewal/Revised (M106) screen opens, do the following:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the pre-filled Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, do the following:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 59 - Legislative interim measures .
Remarks line 1–4: After the pre-filled information, type: “[B112 or B100] error. EI ERB repayment of $[amount repaid].”
Select Update .
Go to step 23.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: select 59 - Legislative interim measures .
Remarks line 1: Type “Client not reached — Repayment of $[total repayment amount].”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Impose D21 from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].” If there are other periods of D21, add the information for each period in the same way.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if a credit of $500 or more will remain in PSCD after the repayment is applied to the client’s account:
In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:
When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the client’s account in PSCD shows the processed transactions, and if only the credit balance remains on file:

ul.li: If no, repeat step 25.
If yes, go to step 27.

step.cmd: Determine if a new address for the client has been documented on the file:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Change of address and then go to step 28 of this procedure. Change of address
If no, go to step 28.

step.cmd: Determine if the client has provided new direct deposit information:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Direct deposit and then go to step 29 of this procedure. Direct deposit
If no, go to step 29.

step.cmd: Send a request to NAR using the iService Catalogue by completing the National Accounting Operations - Request for Refund on Accounts Receivable template as follows:

ul.li: Preferred Language: Select the client’s preferred language.
Origin of the request: Select Citizen (call-center, in-person…) .
Program: Select EI - Employment Insurance .
ID Type: Select Social Insurance Number (SIN) .
ID Number: Enter the client’s SIN.
Address to refund: Select Other (please specify in Additional information field) .
Amount: Enter the amount that the client repaid in error, the remaining amount or the amount to send to the CRA.

Additional information: Enter the appropriate information:
For a repayment made in excess or in error of $500 or more, do the following:
Type “Officer authorized to process benefit repayments [client’s address as shown in FTS] — the client repaid the EI ERB, but after verification, the client was eligible during this period. No other OP must be created on file. Repay $[XXX] to the client.”
If the direct deposit information in FTS is up to date, also type “Issue the payment by direct deposit.”
If, in addition to repaying the client, IPOC must create an OP on the file, also type “IPOC must create an OP of $[XXX].”

For a repayment made in error to Service Canada instead of to the CRA or when the OP is or will be created with the CRA, do the following:
Type “Officer authorized to process benefit repayments [client’s address as shown in FTS] — the client repaid an amount of $[amount] to Service Canada, but after verification, the repayment must be transferred to the CRA. No other OP on file. Transfer the pending amount of $[amount] to the CRA.”
If the request type chosen is Request from Member of Parliament , also type “[Request from member of Parliament, Request from Office for Client Satisfaction or Dire needs]. Process urgently and submit SOBR to IPOC as a priority.”

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Request to reimburse the client sent to National Accounts Receivable.”

Details: Enter the appropriate details:
For a repayment made in excess or in error, type “EI Emergency Response Benefit repayment made in excess or in error by the client. The client must be repaid. A request for refund was sent to National Accounts Receivable. iService reference number [XXXX].”
For a repayment made in error to Service Canada instead of the CRA, type “EI ERB repayment made in error to Service Canada instead of the Canada Revenue Agency. The monies must be transferred to the Canada Revenue Agency. A request for refund was sent to National Accounts Receivable. iService reference number [XXXX].”
Select Save .

step.cmd: Complete the WI.
